correctness.rationale: The spherical addition theorem with probability area normalization yields Gram entries P_l(v_i·v_j). Five-fold geometry has ±1/√5 off diagonal; Legendre parity makes G_even=(1-q)I+qJ (one plus four eigenvalues). Odd signed cycle circulant yields 1 and 1±q twice, where q=5^((l mod2)/2)P_l(1/√5). Independent exact Fraction recurrence gave q_2=-1/5,q_3=-1,q_4=q_8=q_14=-1/5 and verified all ranks/eigenvalue bounds/equality degrees 0..19. Published Bernstein bound at x=1/√5 shows P_l²<√5/[π(l+1/2)]<=1/26 for l>=19 using √5<9/4, π>3, so even |q|<1/5 and odd |q|<√5/5<5/7; both yield strict inequalities. The proof combines exhaustive finite degrees with an all-degree analytic tail. Full row rank means interpolation of five data values, NOT recovery of all 2l+1 harmonic coefficients.
